findings.title: SSM SecureString parameter using default KMS key
findings.description: A SecureString parameter with no key_id encrypts with the default aws/ssm key, which the account cannot rotate or scope via key policy. Point key_id at a customer-managed key.

evidence.expected: key_id set to a customer-managed KMS key

findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.
